description: Class-index Poly-1 classification loss for logits shaped [B, C, ...], adding epsilon times one minus the target-class softmax probability to cross entropy.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"features": synth.Tensor(features), "labels": int(features[:3].argmax())}
ds = synth.Spec("poly1-classifier", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=3)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="tabular-classify", recipe_config={"loss": "poly1-loss", "loss_kwargs": {"epsilon": 1.0}}, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a classifier with Poly-1 loss

name: Poly-1 cross entropy loss

parameters.epsilon: required finite real coefficient greater than or equal to -1
parameters.ignore_index: optional integer class index to exclude (default None)
parameters.reduction: none per target position, mean over valid positions, or sum (default mean)
